spec_match.rationale: The preview uses the real default setHTML() on Chromium 157. The `new Sanitizer()` it constructs is never used, and the code block teaches the withdrawn 2021 API (allowElements / allowAttributes / dropAttributes) that no longer exists in the shipped SanitizerConfig.

interactive.rationale: Snippets, typing and Clear drive the preview. The B/I/code/link/quote toolbar inserts real elements via execCommand while the preview reads innerText, so formatting never reaches the preview (verified: editor 'text', preview 'text').

blurb_alignment.rationale: The 'threat log tracks every element and attribute removed' claim is overstated: it diffs tag-name sets and only looks for on* and javascript: href, and its labels render blank (see open questions).

edge_cases.rationale: Covers script, onerror, javascript:, iframe and a safe case. The 'data: uri' snippet is malformed (nested quotes), so it renders a stray 'injected">' rather than testing data: URLs. The DOMParser fallback misses non-href javascript: sinks such as formaction and xlink:href.

references.rationale: The see-also chromestatus link points to https://chromestatus.com/feature/5786893650231296 (the earlier, unshipped Sanitizer API), not the shipped 5814067399491584. There is no spec link (invariant #3).

conformance.rationale: Feature suite runs 7/7 PASS on Chromium 157, but five assertions are existence checks and only one (setHTML strips <script>) is behavioural; nothing asserts on* handler removal, javascript: URL removal, that setHTML stays safe even with a permissive custom config, that a malformed SanitizerConfig throws TypeError, or what Document.parseHTML returns.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Every snippet, Clear and the B toolbar button were exercised at both viewports with 0 console errors and 0 failed requests, but the threat list contained live SCRIPT/IMG/IFRAME elements (verified). chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification (rule 7b); evidence is Playwright headless Chromium 157.0.8103.78 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch.

telemetry_health.rationale: The shared /public/demo-telemetry.js is injected (runtime/resource errors would be captured) but the page emits no page-specific assertion or interaction events, and /telemetry/demo/events (Basic auth) was not queried in this pass.

design_system.rationale: Uses variables, but the Clear button is fully inline-styled and the threat count colour is set via inline style.color.

accessibility.rationale: The contenteditable has role=textbox and a name but no aria-multiline, the formatting buttons are not grouped in role=toolbar, and neither the preview nor the threat log is a live region. All 12 controls are under 44px. Accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No page-level overflow at 360x740 and the editor/preview stack, but every one of the 12 controls is under 44px tall on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Fix the threat log's innerHTML injection
openQuestions.detail: Threat details such as `<${tag}> removed` and attribute names are written into threatList.innerHTML unescaped. Verified on Chromium 157: the script, onerror and iframe snippets put live SCRIPT, IMG and IFRAME elements into the threat log, and the labels show blank. Render the log with textContent.

openQuestions.title: Correct the chromestatus link to 5814067399491584
openQuestions.detail: The see-also link points to the unshipped predecessor 5786893650231296 (invariant #3 self-heal relies on this id).

openQuestions.title: Replace the obsolete allowElements/allowAttributes/dropAttributes code sample
openQuestions.detail: Use the shipped SanitizerConfig: elements, removeElements, attributes, removeAttributes, replaceWithChildrenElements. Also drop the unused `new Sanitizer()` or actually pass it, and correct the 'never throws' comment: setHTML throws on an invalid config.

openQuestions.title: Make the toolbar affect the preview, or make the editor a plain-text HTML source
openQuestions.detail: The toolbar inserts rendered elements into contenteditable while the preview reads innerText, so B/I/link never show in the preview. Either insert the markup as text or sanitise editor.innerHTML.

openQuestions.title: Fix the malformed data: URI snippet
openQuestions.detail: The snippet's nested quotes break the attribute. Use e.g. <a href="data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>">.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp and inspect the accessibility tree
openQuestions.detail: This pass used Playwright headless Chromium 157 because chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable; repeat the control walk and accessibility-tree inspection through the MCP per rule 7b.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML with setHTML instead of innerHTML
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use Element.setHTML()/Document.parseHTML(); a custom Sanitizer can only restrict, never re-allow XSS-unsafe markup; elements not in `elements` are removed with their content (use replaceWithChildrenElements to keep text); move parsed nodes rather than re-serialising through innerHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Used as the grading reference for this critique (review only, no page edits). The page's fallback paths and its unescaped innerHTML log/readout writes run against this guidance; recorded as open questions.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML with setHTML instead of innerHTML
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never write untrusted strings into innerHTML sinks; use textContent/DOM construction or a sanitizer/Trusted Types policy.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: user-supplied strings reach innerHTML in this page; recorded as a major open question.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group formatting controls in a role=toolbar with roving focus and accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: the formatting buttons are a plain div of buttons; recorded as an open question.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region announcing dynamic log output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamically changing status/log output through an appropriate live region or <output>, keep native semantics and associated labels for controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: the page's changing readouts carry no aria-live/role=status; recorded as an open question.

guidanceConsulted.query: minimum touch target size for buttons on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable (~44px) and content within its space on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review only: measured controls below 44px tall at 360x740; recorded under mobile_desktop_parity.

summary: A real setHTML-backed comment preview. Its threat log is an unescaped innerHTML sink (verified live script/img/iframe nodes injected), its chromestatus link points to the withdrawn predecessor feature, its code sample teaches the obsolete API, and its toolbar never reaches the preview. Verified with Playwright headless Chromium 157, not chrome-devtools-mcp.
